title: RunRecord
description: Execution metadata of one agent-stage execution attempt (one agent run). Read-only view derived from the execution store; it never contains prompts, task objectives, inputs, agent output or conversation content. Absent metric = not reported (never a stand-in zero).

attempt.description: Stage attempt this run belongs to. An attempt refunded after an interruption is reused, so (stage, attempt) is not unique; run_id is.

session_agent.description: Name the SDK session ran the harness agent definition under (dae-<agent_id>).

session_id.description: SDK session identifier (the transcript stays in the SDK's session store).

duration_ms.description: Harness wall clock, started_at to completed_at.

sdk_duration_ms.description: Duration reported by the SDK ResultMessage.

total_tokens.description: input_tokens + output_tokens, present only when both are known.

metrics_source.description: result: final SDK ResultMessage; partial: usage seen on assistant messages before the run stopped (lower bound, no cost/turns).

sdk_metadata.description: Small, serializable SDK facts (model, versions, usage breakdown, terminal reason, ...). Never message content.
